challenges.title: Repair the last commit message
challenges.objective: Change the current commit message from WIP to Document launch checklist. Preserve the committed file tree and one-commit history.
challenges.brief:
Change the current commit message from WIP to Document launch checklist. Preserve the committed file tree and one-commit history.

Work only in this synthetic repository. Checks inspect repository semantics, not commit hashes.

Key reference: git help; this repository has no remotes, credentials, or signing keys.

The starter repository is initialized before the shell opens. Preserve its synthetic history and unrelated files.
hints: An amendment replaces the current commit while retaining its parent relationship.
git commit --amend -m 'Document launch checklist'.
challenges.explanation: Amending rewrites a commit identity. This is a disposable unpublished repository, so no shared history is affected.
challenges.reference_solution: git commit --amend -qm 'Document launch checklist'

challenges.title: Describe the current jj change
challenges.objective: Set the current change description to Add launch notes. Preserve notes.txt containing the supplied text.
challenges.brief:
Set the current change description to Add launch notes. Preserve notes.txt containing the supplied text.

Work only in this synthetic repository. Checks inspect repository semantics, not commit hashes.

Key reference: jj help; this repository has no remotes, credentials, or signing keys.

The starter repository is initialized before the shell opens. Preserve its synthetic history and unrelated files.
hints: The working copy is a change in jj and can have a description before any separate commit action.
Use jj describe -m 'Add launch notes'.
challenges.explanation: jj tracks working-copy content in the current change. Describing that change does not require Git staging.
challenges.reference_solution: jj describe -m 'Add launch notes'

challenges.title: Name a completed change
challenges.objective: Create a bookmark named launch on the current change, whose description is Prepare launch. Then create a new empty working-copy change on top. Preserve notes.txt.
challenges.brief:
Create a bookmark named launch on the current change, whose description is Prepare launch. Then create a new empty working-copy change on top. Preserve notes.txt.

Work only in this synthetic repository. Checks inspect repository semantics, not commit hashes.

Key reference: jj help; this repository has no remotes, credentials, or signing keys.

The starter repository is initialized before the shell opens. Preserve its synthetic history and unrelated files.
hints: A bookmark names a change; jj new creates a child and moves the working copy.
Use jj bookmark create launch -r @ followed by jj new.
challenges.explanation: The bookmark stays on the finished change while the working copy advances to a new child. The check tests ancestry and emptiness instead of hash values.
challenges.reference_solution:
jj bookmark create launch -r @
jj new

checks.name: bookmark topology
